meta.name: database-design
meta.description: Database design and schema engineering for relational databases. Use for SQL schema design, ORM model authoring, migration strategies (Alembic, Liquibase, Flyway, Drizzle), query optimisation, indexing decisions, normalisation vs denormalisation trade-offs, and data-integrity constraints. Trigger phrases: "design this schema", "write a migration", "optimise this query", "model these entities", "add an index". NOT for NoSQL/document stores — use a dedicated NoSQL skill for those. NOT for ETL pipelines or data warehousing at scale — those involve different trade-offs. NOT for ORM configuration (framework setup) — this skill is about DATA SHAPE, not connection pooling or ORM bootstrap.
